charts.title: TOI-544 b: orbits around TOI-544
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-544's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-544 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Osborne et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.52711138O), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname OSBORNE_ET_AL_2024): P 1.548352 d

charts.title: TOI-544 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-544 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (6, 32, 98) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 50618703, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 5-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 5-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
